items.title: John Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 18, 2023 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: last week’s show there was at least four new singers out there, or jazz musicians like Isaiah and Benny Benack III and Samara Joy and this girl Katie Kortum.

ctx.x: You can use that in your next song, okay, I give you permission.

That’s pretty good. Well you know we’ve done the show for eighteen years I think. And it’s been a great way to keep up on what everybody’s doing, you know that’s the one thing I really like about it is we — and unfortunately it’s the bane of Spotify in that you can go onto Spotify or actually I go to iTunes and there’s new releases. And I can hear just what the new releases are and find them and try to you know incorporate, you know there is a lot of great new music out there. There’s a lot of great singers, male…
Do you have people contacting you like boy I wish you’d play this — play my record?
